- What do you do?
- Why are you here?

## Okay! Now you know 6 people! {.scrollable}

```{r}
#| label: maps
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
country <- read_csv("assets/country.csv") |>
  mutate(alpha.3 = ISO3_Country) |>
  group_by(alpha.3) |>
  summarise(n = n())
map <- st_read("assets/tiled_grid_mapped.geojson") |>
  left_join(country, by = "alpha.3")

ggplot(map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = n.y), color = NA) +
  geom_label(data = map[!is.na(map$n.y),], aes(x= coord_x, y = coord_y, label = `alpha.2`), label.size = NA, fill = NA, color = "#00A99D") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "gray70", high = "black", na.value = "grey90") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "Number of participants") +
  theme_void()
```
